title: World Models Need More Intelligence, Says Luma CEO Amit Jain
summary: <p>The AI boom has been built largely on progress in language models, but a different approach has gained enormous attention in the industry this year: world models, which are designed to generate accurate predictions about the physical world, rather than words and numbers.</p> <p>I sat down with Amit Jain, co-founder and CEO of Luma AI, to discuss the promise of world models&mdash;and where current approaches to training them still fall short&mdash;on the <a href="h
